I’d fix these before merging. Reviewed `excerpt-helper` at `59856d7` against `main`; no files changed.

1. **[P1] Short text is truncated and always gets an ellipsis** — `src/excerpt.js:6–8`  
   There’s no early return when the text fits. `excerpt('hello world', 20)` returns `"hello…"` instead of `"hello world"`; `excerpt('hello', 5)` returns `"hello…"`, and empty input returns `"…"`. This contradicts the documented contract. Check the length before finding a cut point.

2. **[P2] A word ending exactly at the limit is unnecessarily dropped** — `src/words.js:2–3`  
   `slice(0, limit)` excludes the space at index `limit`. Consequently, `excerpt('one two three', 7)` returns `"one…"` rather than `"one two…"`, even though both words fit. Include the boundary at the limit when searching.

3. **[P2] The helpers aren’t connected to card rendering** — `src/excerpt.js:5–8`, integration point `src/card.js:2`  
   `card()` still returns `entry.body.trim()`; neither `excerpt()` nor `toPlain()` is called anywhere outside tests. As submitted, the branch doesn’t change the preview under cards. Wire the helpers into that path and add an end-to-end card test.

4. **[P2] Markdown conversion deletes literal content** — `src/plain.js:3`  
   Removing every underscore, asterisk, tilde and backtick isn’t equivalent to removing Markdown delimiters. For example, `toPlain('foo_bar')` returns `"foobar"`, and ``toPlain('`a * b`')`` returns `"a b"`. Plain-text conversion should preserve literal punctuation and code contents.

5. **[P2] Common Markdown markers remain in previews** — `src/plain.js:3–5`  
   `toPlain('# Heading\n\n- first item')` returns `"# Heading - first item"`, and `toPlain('![photo](https://x/img.png)')` returns `"!photo"`. Headings, lists and images therefore don’t satisfy the README’s “markers removed” behavior.

**Validation:** all 4 existing tests pass, but they cover only happy paths and miss these cases.
